scope: Move active native examples to formal Engine/HostRenderer entries; exercise declaration, update, layout/presentation, window and pointer interaction, generation-gated lifecycle, injected external text/IME display, accessibility, resource rejection, retirement and a release performance baseline.

commands.all_targets_check: scripts/verify-in-vm.sh env CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo check --locked --features desktop,native-engine-cpu --tests --examples
commands.integration: scripts/verify-in-vm.sh env CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 JASPER_UI_TEST_FONT=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf cargo test --locked --no-default-features --features native-engine-cpu --test native_item5_journey
commands.window_once: scripts/verify-in-vm.sh env CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x720x24' cargo run --locked --features desktop,native-engine-cpu --example window -- /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf --once
commands.window_click: scripts/verify-in-vm.sh env CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 scripts/interact-window-xvfb.sh /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf evidence/item5-window-interaction
commands.window_capture: scripts/verify-in-vm.sh env CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 scripts/capture-window-xvfb.sh /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf evidence/item5-window-xvfb

results.host_lifecycle: HostRenderer accepts focus, pointer, scroll, accessibility and rendering only for the exact active Surface generation; reconfigure, suspend, resume and retirement reject stale epochs
results.public_boundary: hello, pointer, window, gpu_window and full_scene contain no native_adapter, Blitz, AnyRender, LegacyEngine or experiments path import; each consumes engine::Engine or native::host::HostRenderer
results.visual_switch: a style-only SceneUpdate preserves scene focus, viewport scroll and accessibility focus/action; incremental scrolled output equals a fresh native import
results.interaction: pointer down survives the visual frame and pointer up emits exactly one activation
results.external_text: authoritative snapshot, binding rotation, focus, preedit repaint/cancel and retirement passed through public native::host types
results.resource_failures: empty font stack and insufficient frame budget are rejected; rejected writes preserve host bytes and the following valid render succeeds
results.window_x11: the 800x600 window and resized 640x360 X11 protocol Surface both presented; the host-owned window shows the expected background, button and text. The llvmpipe Vulkan example completed one presented frame.

performance.paint_mechanism: force invalidate_frame, then time one full layout/paint and host Surface adaptation; one warmup discarded

debug_comparison.scope: debug diagnostic only; not the optimization baseline

performance.optimization_gate: Use release median/P95 as the same-VM regression reference; establish a cross-host threshold after final release-host acceptance.

limitations: The external text and IME path consumes a synchronous host-injected service snapshot. No live editor or IME engine is implemented or claimed.
Accessibility is verified through the public snapshot/action API; no platform AT-SPI, UIA or system accessibility bridge was executed.
Xvfb is a real X11 protocol Surface but not a compositor, window manager, hardware display controller or vsync source.
The performance number is a same-VM regression baseline, not a hardware display, GPU or cross-host latency guarantee.
Whole-frame and window-adapter formal composition obligations are registered in docs/claude-item5-proof-backlog.md for Claude.
